mainEntity.name: Can these navy Muay Thai shorts be customized for a gym or brand?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use this design as a development reference for your own artwork, waistband label and size plan. Confirm the fabric, panel layout, decoration and measurements through a mockup and physical sample.

mainEntity.name: How do Muay Thai shorts differ from 2-in-1 grappling shorts?

acceptedAnswer.text: This reference uses a wide-leg striking-short silhouette and side openings. A 2-in-1 grappling short adds a fitted inner layer. Select the construction according to coverage, movement and training requirements; no liner is confirmed for this reference.

mainEntity.name: What is the material and GSM?

acceptedAnswer.text: The images show a satin-look shell, but final fiber composition and GSM have not been confirmed. Request the actual fabric specification and inspect the material before approving bulk production.

mainEntity.name: What should I send for a custom Muay Thai shorts quotation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send artwork, estimated quantity by size, target measurements, waistband and split preferences, labels, delivery country and target timing. MOQ, sample timing and pricing depend on the confirmed brief.

mainEntity.name: Is the video real product test footage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The supplied video is a generated promotional visualization. Use the approved physical sample to assess fit, materials, movement and construction.
